subject: PICTURE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-09-09 (kb/Work PB528), SECOND SENTENCE ENFORCED 2026-09-13 (kb/Work PB530, train 31). Sentence 1 - 'For fixed insertion with editing sign control symbols, only one currency symbol and only one editing sign control symbol may be used in character-string-1' - is PictureComposition's: PIC +999+ and PIC $999$ are COBOL1934 (golden entries PB11/PB12). It turns on which occurrences are FIXED insertion, so it rests on 13.18.40.5 rule 6's definition of a floating string - 'a string of at least two IDENTICAL floating insertion editing symbols', with the simple insertion symbols and (rule 6 b) the decimal point embedded - an ADJACENCY property with ONE home, PictureComposition.FloatingString, read both by this rule and by PictureAnalyzer's geometry; the bare occurrence COUNT it replaced read PIC +999+ and PIC $999$ as floating strings and silently answered a question the source never asked (MOVE -12 through PIC +999+ rendered '-0012'). The legal neighbours are all rendered in the positive golden: $999+, 999$+, +$$99, $$$9.99, ++. SENTENCE 2 - 'For extended editing sign control symbols, either one or two extended editing sign control symbols may be used in character-string-1' (cite.py --check 13.18.40.3 PASS) - is asked in PictureComposition.Validate over the PICTURE (kb/Work PB855 moved it there from PictureAnalyzer.ValidateEditing, where it counted EDITING PHRASES): a symbol is an OCCURRENCE - each non-floating occurrence of a FOR-phrase character-1 is one and a floating string of one character-1 is one - so `PIC 9L9F9G` with three phrases AND `PIC L9L9L` with ONE phrase are COBOL1985 (negative/pb530-picture-editing-extended-count PX01/PX02), and Annex D.24's `PIC LLLL9.99F` (a floating L string and one F) is two and legal. The same bound keeps the position-ambiguous role search of the Table-10 walk at 2^4 assignments. A FOR-phrase character-1's floating-ness is rule 6's ADJACENCY test and not a count (PictureComposition.HasFloatingString, read by ValidateEditing for EditRule.Floating): `PIC L999L`, two FIXED occurrences, used to be read as one floating string and rendered '(0012' for -12; it renders '(012('.
